title: Destination
description: Travel destination with name, country, description, image, rating, and popularity status. Used for travel guides, destination discovery, and tourism platforms.

name.description: Name of the travel destination (city, region, or landmark)

country.description: Country where the destination is located

description.description: Detailed description of the destination, attractions, and travel information

image.description: URL to a representative image of the destination

rating.description: Average traveler rating, typically on a scale of 1-5

popular.description: Whether this destination is popular or trending
